intro: The Raven Claw Talisman is a sacred night elf relic tied to the Druids of the Talon. Kept deep within Ban'ethil Barrow Den on Teldrassil, it is one of the four essential Relics of Wakening required to safely guide slumbering druids back from the Emerald Dream.

p: The Raven Claw Talisman is preserved within a designated chest inside Ban'ethil Barrow Den, the subterranean sanctuary where Teldrassil's Druids of the Talon entered their deep meditative slumbers. Druidic hibernation is a delicate spiritual threshold. If a druid's link to the waking world is shattered without the proper ceremonial focus, their spirit risks being stranded within the Emerald Dream indefinitely. Alongside the Black Feather Quill, the Sapphire of Sky, and the Rune of Nesting, the talisman is required by Athridas Bearmantle in Dolanaar to conduct the ritual of awakening and bring the slumberers back safely.

sections.t: The Threat in the Barrow Den
p: When corrupted Gnarlpine furbolgs overran Ban'ethil Barrow Den, the sacred chests and the sleeping druids fell into immediate peril. The furbolg desecration severed the sanctum from outside aid and put the relics in danger of being lost or destroyed. Athridas Bearmantle tasks defenders of Teldrassil with braving the winding earthen corridors of the den to secure the Raven Claw Talisman before the displaced druids are lost to the Dream forever.
